Method of Attack: Supply-chain attack modifying the legitimate Bash Uploader tool to exfiltrate environment variables containing sensitive information such as keys, tokens, and credentials from CI/CD environments
Attack Vector: Compromised Codecov Bash Uploader tool used in CI/CD pipelines
Date of Discovery: Reported by BleepingComputer last month (relative to May 2021)
Indicators of Compromise: Attacker IP addresses associated with the supply-chain attack (disclosed by Codecov)
